subject.title: feat: add account feed model API

question: Should these endpoints wait for durable monotonic revisions and deterministic continuation before becoming stable v1, or should the bounded no-cursor projection ship under an explicitly experimental contract?
rationale: The branch currently publishes placeholder revision and completeness semantics as stable v1, while the referenced RFC remains open and collaborator review identifies this as a client-visible contract decision rather than a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Complete stable v1 semantics
options.body: Require durable revisions, opaque deterministic continuation, and truthful completeness before merging the public v1 contract.

options.title: Ship an experimental contract
options.body: Move or mark the bounded projection as experimental so clients cannot rely on sequence zero and null cursors as permanent v1 behavior.

options.title: Pause for RFC resolution
options.body: Hold the PR until the hosted-feed RFC settles the revision and continuation requirements shared with OpenClaw consumers.

recommendation.title: Complete stable v1 semantics
recommendation.body: Require durable revisions, opaque deterministic continuation, and truthful completeness before merging the public v1 contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the detailed current-head contract review and are the strongest evidence-backed owner for resolving the stable-versus-experimental boundary.
